page_title: NEW 5-1 SHU | Newcastle v Sheffield Utd 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+7' Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Sheffield Utd will take a free kick near the side line.
90+2' Referee Tony Harrington reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
90+1' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

90' Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
88' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Martin Dubravka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Anthony Gordon will be replaced by Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd).
82' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd) replaces Lewis Hall.
81' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' It's time for a substitution. Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Gustavo Hamer.
79' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
78' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Martin Dubravka comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) dribbles into the box, but Wesley Foderingham is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
75' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a short corner kick.
74' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

74' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
73' The attendance for today's match is 52196.
72' 5 - 1 Goal! Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Harvey Barnes, then sends the ball into the top right corner. 5:1.

71' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Wesley Foderingham leaps like a salmon to deny him.
70' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) replacing Andre Brooks.

68' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Wesley Foderingham is alert and denies him with a nice save.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cameron Archer walks off the pitch to be replaced by William Osula (Sheffield Utd).
67' That will be all from Mason Holgate who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd).
67' Here is a change. Elliot Anderson is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
66' Substitution. Jacob Murphy makes his way off the pitch and Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) comes on as his replacement.

65' 4 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 4:1.
65' Corner kick. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is ready to send the ball into the box.
64' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
63' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
63' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
62' A pass lands at the feet of Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
61' 3 - 1 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wesley Foderingham into the bottom right corner.
60' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
59' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Newcastle, he's going to review using VAR.
58' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tony Harrington signals. Newcastle are about to take a penalty!

58' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Martin Dubravka guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
56' Half-chance! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) plays a pass into the box, but Wesley Foderingham reacts well to snuff out the attack.

54' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Gordon flights the free kick into the box, where Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 2:1.
52' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Sean Longstaff, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
51' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) nutmegs the defender and goes for goal from distance, but the shot flies high over the bar.
49' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
46' Eddie Howe has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Emil Krafth comes on the pitch for Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Wesley Foderingham stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.

45+2' Gustavo Hamer sprays a wonderful pass out to Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Martin Dubravka problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
45+1' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The cross into the penalty area from Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
42' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
41' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Tony Harrington immediately signals a free kick.
34' That's unlucky! Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
33' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wesley Foderingham intercepts the ball.

31' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the left post and ricochets away! Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
31' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

30' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. Sheffield Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' A rebound falls at the feet of Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
29' The total number of attempts is 6:6. The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Jacob Murphy sets up Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
25' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) zig-zags his way into the box and directs a shot into the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
24' Jacob Murphy drives to the by-line and dinks a lovely cross into the middle of the box. Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) wins the ball but his header is just over the bar.
23' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) tries to find Cameron Archer, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
21' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Wesley Foderingham.
20' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Newcastle get a free kick.
20' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
17' The resulting set piece from Sheffield Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

16' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. It's a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
11' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.

5' 0 - 1 Gustavo Hamer showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header down into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
5' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
4' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Sheffield Utd as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Sheffield Utd will take the kick-off.
Tony Harrington was nominated as the referee for this game.
